notes.title: ANIME WAR — Modern Campaign now features BOOBS!
notes.content:
[h3]So there are two things to it, really.[/h3]

[h3]First and foremost, we updated the physics of our character.[/h3] So boobs are now naturally moving as your character moves!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/tb7XVMP.gif[/img]


[h3]And secondly, we have added a nudity DLC which allows you to enjoy the moving boobs ten times better![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1251350/ANIME_WAR__Modern_Campaign__Nudity_DLC_18/
